source.claim: Official Codex model guidance identifies Astra as its most capable model and lists Codex CLI availability; GPT-6.1 Sol, which supersedes GPT-6 Sol, is described as near-Astra performance at lower cost, not as more capable.

Official model overview identifies Fable 5.1 for demanding reasoning and long-horizon agentic work, with Opus 5.5 the starting point for most workloads; Claude Mythos 5.1 appears only in pricing as limited availability.
